tools.name: exoscale_list_zones
tools.description: List the Exoscale zones (data centers) with their API and object-storage endpoints. Compute, storage and network resources live in one zone each. GET /zone.

tools.name: exoscale_get_organization
tools.description: The Exoscale organization of the API key: id, name, address, country, account balance and currency. GET /organization.

tools.name: exoscale_list_quotas
tools.description: Resource quotas of the organization: for each resource its current usage and limit (instances, volumes, elastic IPs, and so on). GET /quota.

tools.name: exoscale_get_quota
tools.description: Usage and limit of one quota entity, for example 'instance'. Use exoscale_list_quotas for the names. GET /quota/{entity}.

tools.name: exoscale_get_usage_report
tools.description: Aggregated usage of the organization for one month: product, variable, quantity and unit per line. GET /usage-report.

tools.name: exoscale_list_instances
tools.description: List the compute instances of one zone: id, name, state, instance type, template, IP addresses and security groups. Call once per zone for a full inventory. GET /instance.

tools.name: exoscale_get_instance
tools.description: Details of one compute instance: state, type, template, disk size, networks, security groups, elastic IPs, snapshots. The cloud-init user-data is never returned. GET /instance/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_start_instance
tools.description: WRITE: start a stopped compute instance (normal boot, no rescue profile). Billing for the instance resumes. Returns an operation; poll it with exoscale_get_operation. PUT /instance/{id}:start.

tools.name: exoscale_stop_instance
tools.description: WRITE: stop a running compute instance. Running services go down and the public IP may change unless it is an elastic IP. Returns an operation; poll it with exoscale_get_operation. PUT /instance/{id}:stop.

tools.name: exoscale_reboot_instance
tools.description: WRITE: reboot a running compute instance. Running services restart and unsaved data in memory is lost. Returns an operation; poll it with exoscale_get_operation. PUT /instance/{id}:reboot.

tools.name: exoscale_get_operation
tools.description: State of an asynchronous operation (pending, success, failure, timeout), for example the reply of a start, stop or reboot. Use the same zone as the call that created it. GET /operation/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_instance_types
tools.description: List the compute instance types: family, size, CPUs, GPUs, memory and the zones that offer them. GET /instance-type.

tools.name: exoscale_get_instance_type
tools.description: Details of one instance type: family, size, CPUs, GPUs, memory, zones. GET /instance-type/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_templates
tools.description: List the compute templates (OS images) of a zone: name, family, version, default user, size, visibility. The public list is long: filter by family or page with limit/offset. GET /template.

tools.name: exoscale_get_template
tools.description: Details of one template: name, family, version, default user, size, boot mode, checksum, zones. GET /template/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_security_groups
tools.description: List the security groups of a zone: id, name, description and external sources (firewall), with the rules when the API includes them. GET /security-group.

tools.name: exoscale_get_security_group
tools.description: Details of one security group: description and external sources, with the rules (protocol, ports, network, direction) when the API includes them. GET /security-group/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_elastic_ips
tools.description: List the elastic IP addresses of a zone with description, address family, health-check settings and labels. GET /elastic-ip.

tools.name: exoscale_get_elastic_ip
tools.description: Details of one elastic IP: address, CIDR, family, description, health check and labels. GET /elastic-ip/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_block_storage_volumes
tools.description: List the block storage volumes of a zone: name, size, state, the instance each is attached to, encryption and snapshots. GET /block-storage.

tools.name: exoscale_get_block_storage_volume
tools.description: Details of one block storage volume: size, block size, state, attached instance, encryption, labels and snapshots. GET /block-storage/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_sks_clusters
tools.description: List the Scalable Kubernetes Service (SKS) clusters of a zone: name, version, state, level, CNI, endpoint and node pools. GET /sks-cluster.

tools.name: exoscale_get_sks_cluster
tools.description: Details of one SKS cluster: version, state, level, CNI, add-ons, OIDC settings (no secrets), endpoint and node pools. GET /sks-cluster/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_dns_domains
tools.description: List the DNS domains (zones) hosted at Exoscale: id, unicode name, creation date. DNS is the same in every zone. GET /dns-domain.

tools.name: exoscale_get_dns_domain
tools.description: Details of one DNS domain. GET /dns-domain/{id}.

tools.name: exoscale_list_dns_records
tools.description: List the records of one DNS domain: name, type, content, TTL, priority. Use exoscale_list_dns_domains for the domain id. GET /dns-domain/{domain-id}/record.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "exoscale_get_sks_cluster" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Details of one SKS cluster: version, state, level, CNI, add-ons, OIDC settings (no secrets), endpoint and node pools. GET /sks-cluster/{id}.
